finding_or_allegation: The Paris court civil release verifies the underlying criminal judgment on authors, accomplices and connected offences; report records Abdeslam whole-life term. Full criminal reasons not retrieved.
Court allocated joint civil liability for the qualifying convictions, with stated exceptions. Civil allocation does not make all persons physical perpetrators.
Europol describes three coordinated teams and IS membership of attack participants. Inquiry separately documents cross-border investigation; individual roles require the criminal findings.
IS publicly claimed attacks. This claim is separate from investigation and criminal findings.
January attacks shared proceeding; Polat received life on appeal, distinct from perpetration by the Kouachi brothers or Coulibaly.
AQAP said it selected, planned and financed the Charlie Hebdo attack. Europol records the claim and assesses probable training for one attacker. Independent transaction evidence not verified.
Europol records Coulibaly pledge to IS and association with Charlie Hebdo attackers. His statement on synchronisation is attributed to him; joint AQAP–IS command is unverified.
Life sentence for El Khazzani upheld on appeal. National adjudication separate from original statistical slot.
Four defendants acquitted on alleged complicity in synagogue attack. Separate charges or later review not resolved here.
